title: dab sprite
description: A character-grid sprite: rows of characters and the palette they mean. FORMAT.md is the prose; rules that relate one field to another (row widths, characters in the palette, indices in range, unique names, levels and slices in step, nesting depth) are the validator's, and FORMAT.md lists them.

stack.description: Which way its slices go from its grid: back (the grid the front) or down (the grid the top, seen from above). Back unless given.

colour.description: #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa for a colour you can see through.

colours.description: Character → colour. One printable ASCII character a key, never `.`, which is transparent.

body.description: A grid and everything that colours it — what a sprite, a part and a level share.

variants.description: Named colourways, each overriding some of the palette's characters.

animations.description: Named runs of frame indices, in playing order; a repeat is a hold.

frames.description: One entry per frame: h rows of w characters.

part.description: A placement on its parent, and either its own body or a `use` naming another sprite.

not.description: A flipped part carries no parts of its own.

level.description: The subject at another size: its own body, the sprite's frame count, the sprite's animations.

slice.description: What lies a voxel further back than the grid in front of it, as seen from in front: frames, the sprite's frame count, in the sprite's size and colours, and perhaps a name.

name.description: A label for whoever draws it. Its path is still its place, #n.
